body.id: Galileo mengamati langit malam demi malam. Marie Curie mengolah berton-ton bijih selama bertahun-tahun.
body.en: Galileo watched the sky night after night. Marie Curie processed tons of ore for years.

body.id: Di unit ini Anda juga membaca sumber pendek: catatan Galileo dan alasan resmi Komite Nobel.
body.en: In this unit you will also read short sources: Galileo's report and the Nobel Committee's official citation.

body.id: Pada 1903, Wright bersaudara terbang 12 detik dengan pesawat bermesin. Puluhan tahun kemudian, B.J. Habibie membantu membuat pesawat lebih ringan dan aman.
body.en: In 1903 the Wright brothers flew a powered aircraft for 12 seconds. Decades later, B.J. Habibie helped make aircraft lighter and safer.

body.id: Keduanya menguji, mengukur, dan menguji lagi. Anda juga akan membaca catatan penerbangan 1903 dan Keputusan Presiden tentang Hari Kebangkitan Teknologi Nasional.
body.en: Both tested, measured and tested again. You will also read the 1903 flight record and the presidential decree on National Technology Awakening Day.

body.id: Galileo melaporkan pengamatannya dalam buku Sidereus Nuncius («Pesan dari Bintang-Bintang», 1610). Isinya, secara ringkas:
body.en: Galileo reported his observations in the book Sidereus Nuncius ("The Starry Messenger", 1610). In brief:

body.id: Pada 7 Januari 1610 ia melihat tiga «bintang kecil» di dekat Jupiter. Malam berikutnya, posisi ketiganya sudah berubah. Beberapa hari kemudian ia melihat empat.
body.en: On 7 January 1610 he saw three "little stars" near Jupiter. The next night their positions had changed. A few days later he saw four.

body.id: Karena titik-titik itu selalu ikut bersama Jupiter sambil berpindah posisi, ia menyimpulkan bahwa mereka beredar mengelilingi Jupiter, seperti Bulan mengelilingi Bumi.
body.en: Because the dots always travelled with Jupiter while changing places, he concluded that they circle Jupiter, as the Moon circles the Earth.

body.id: Sumber: Galileo Galilei, Sidereus Nuncius (Venesia, 1610), diringkas.
body.en: Source: Galileo Galilei, Sidereus Nuncius (Venice, 1610), summarised.

title.en: The 1911 Nobel Prize in Chemistry citation

body.id: Setiap Hadiah Nobel disertai alasan resmi. Untuk Nobel Kimia 1911, hadiah diberikan kepada Marie Curie:
body.en: Every Nobel Prize comes with an official citation. The 1911 Nobel Prize in Chemistry went to Marie Curie:

body.id: «sebagai pengakuan atas jasanya bagi kemajuan ilmu kimia melalui penemuan unsur radium dan polonium, melalui pemisahan radium, dan penelitian tentang sifat serta senyawa unsur yang luar biasa ini» (terjemahan bebas).
body.en: "in recognition of her services to the advancement of chemistry by the discovery of the elements radium and polonium, by the isolation of radium and the study of the nature and compounds of this remarkable element."

body.id: Sumber: nobelprize.org, The Nobel Prize in Chemistry 1911.
body.en: Source: nobelprize.org, The Nobel Prize in Chemistry 1911.

body.id: Hari itu Wright bersaudara melakukan empat penerbangan di dekat Kitty Hawk, Carolina Utara. Dua di antaranya, diringkas:
body.en: That day the Wright brothers made four flights near Kitty Hawk, North Carolina. Two of them, in brief:

body.id: Penerbangan pertama, pukul 10.35: Orville sebagai pilot, 12 detik, sekitar 37 meter.
body.en: First flight, 10:35 a.m.: Orville at the controls, 12 seconds, about 37 metres (120 feet).

body.id: Penerbangan keempat: Wilbur sebagai pilot, 59 detik, sekitar 260 meter.
body.en: Fourth flight: Wilbur at the controls, 59 seconds, about 260 metres (852 feet).

body.id: Sumber: History.com, First airplane flies (17 Desember 1903); National Park Service, The Road to the First Flight.
body.en: Source: History.com, First airplane flies (17 December 1903); National Park Service, The Road to the First Flight.

body.id: Keputusan Presiden ini menimbang bahwa keberhasilan uji terbang pertama pesawat N-250 buatan IPTN pada 10 Agustus 1995 merupakan prestasi putra-putri bangsa yang membanggakan di bidang teknologi (diringkas).
body.en: The decree notes that the first successful test flight of the N-250, built by IPTN, on 10 August 1995 was a proud achievement by the nation's own people in technology (summarised).

body.id: Bunyi keputusannya: «Tanggal 10 Agustus ditetapkan sebagai Hari Kebangkitan Teknologi Nasional.»
body.en: Its decision reads: "10 August is designated as National Technology Awakening Day" (translation).

body.id: Sumber: Keputusan Presiden Republik Indonesia Nomor 71 Tahun 1995 (peraturan.go.id).
body.en: Source: Presidential Decree of the Republic of Indonesia No. 71 of 1995 (peraturan.go.id).

title.en: Galileo and the moons of Jupiter

ST-A-GALILEO.source: HAO/UCAR: Galileo Galilei (1564–1642); Galileo, Sidereus Nuncius (1610); Astronomy.com: Jan. 7, 1610, Galileo sees four moons of Jupiter

caption.id: Galileo Galilei lahir di Pisa, Italia, pada 15 Februari 1564. Ia suka menguji gagasan dengan percobaan dan pengukuran.
caption.en: Galileo Galilei was born in Pisa, Italy, on 15 February 1564. He liked to test ideas with experiments and measurements.

caption.id: Pada masanya, banyak orang yakin bahwa semua benda langit beredar mengelilingi Bumi. Galileo ingin melihat langit dengan lebih jelas.
caption.en: In his time many people believed every heavenly body circled the Earth. Galileo wanted to see the sky more clearly.

caption.id: Pada 1609 ia membuat teropong sendiri dan mengarahkannya ke langit. Ia melihat gunung dan lembah di Bulan.
caption.en: In 1609 he built his own telescope and pointed it at the sky. He saw mountains and valleys on the Moon.

caption.id: Mulai 7 Januari 1610, ia mengamati Jupiter malam demi malam dan menggambar titik-titik terang di dekatnya. Titik-titik itu berpindah: empat bulan sedang mengelilingi Jupiter.
caption.en: From 7 January 1610 he watched Jupiter night after night, drawing the bright dots beside it. The dots moved: four moons were circling Jupiter.

caption.id: Temuannya mendukung gagasan bahwa Bumi beredar mengelilingi Matahari, gagasan yang ditentang banyak orang. Pada 1633 ia diadili di Roma dan harus tinggal di rumah sampai akhir hayatnya.
caption.en: His findings supported the idea that the Earth goes around the Sun, an idea many people opposed. In 1633 he was tried in Rome and confined to his home for the rest of his life.

caption.id: Di dalam rumah pun ia terus menulis; bukunya tentang gerak terbit pada 1638. Galileo wafat pada 8 Januari 1642, meninggalkan teladan: amati dengan teliti, catat, dan uji lagi.
caption.en: Even confined at home he kept writing; his book on motion came out in 1638. Galileo died on 8 January 1642, leaving an example: observe carefully, record, and test again.

ST-A-CURIE.source: nobelprize.org: Marie Curie – Facts (Physics 1903) dan The Nobel Prize in Chemistry 1911; History.com: Curies isolate radium; The Christian Science Monitor (2011): Why her papers are still radioactive

caption.id: Maria Skłodowska lahir di Warsawa, kini di Polandia, pada 7 November 1867. Pada 1891 ia pindah ke Paris untuk kuliah di Sorbonne.
caption.en: Maria Skłodowska was born in Warsaw, in today's Poland, on 7 November 1867. In 1891 she moved to Paris to study at the Sorbonne.

caption.id: Pada 1896, para ilmuwan menemukan bahwa uranium memancarkan sinar yang tak terlihat. Marie ingin tahu dari mana sinar itu berasal, dan apakah unsur lain juga begitu.
caption.en: In 1896 scientists found that uranium gives off invisible rays. Marie wanted to know where the rays came from, and whether other elements did the same.

caption.id: Bersama suaminya, Pierre Curie, ia meneliti bijih uranium bernama pitchblende. Pada 1898 mereka mengumumkan dua unsur baru: polonium dan radium.
caption.en: With her husband Pierre Curie she studied a uranium ore called pitchblende. In 1898 they announced two new elements: polonium and radium.

caption.id: Untuk membuktikannya, mereka mengolah berton-ton bijih di laboratorium yang sederhana. Pada 1902 Marie berhasil memperoleh sepersepuluh gram radium klorida murni.
caption.en: To prove it, they processed tons of ore in a simple laboratory. In 1902 Marie obtained one-tenth of a gram of pure radium chloride.

caption.id: Ia meraih Nobel Fisika 1903 bersama Pierre Curie dan Henri Becquerel, lalu Nobel Kimia 1911. Ia orang pertama yang meraih dua Hadiah Nobel.
caption.en: She shared the 1903 Nobel Prize in Physics with Pierre Curie and Henri Becquerel, then won the 1911 Nobel Prize in Chemistry. She was the first person to win two Nobel Prizes.

caption.id: Marie Curie wafat pada 4 Juli 1934, kemungkinan karena paparan radiasi selama bertahun-tahun. Kisahnya mengajak kita tekun meneliti sekaligus menjaga keselamatan.
caption.en: Marie Curie died on 4 July 1934, probably from years of exposure to radiation. Her story asks us to research patiently and with care for safety.

title.en: The Wright brothers and the first flight

ST-A-WRIGHT.source: National Park Service (Wright Brothers National Memorial): The Road to the First Flight; History.com: First airplane flies (December 17, 1903)

caption.id: Wilbur dan Orville Wright adalah kakak beradik dari Dayton, Ohio, Amerika Serikat. Pada 1892 mereka membuka toko sepeda.
caption.en: Wilbur and Orville Wright were brothers from Dayton, Ohio, in the United States. In 1892 they opened a bicycle shop.

caption.id: Usaha sepeda melatih ketelitian mereka, dan keuntungannya membiayai percobaan terbang. Masalah terbesarnya: bagaimana mengendalikan pesawat di udara?
caption.en: Bicycle work sharpened their skills, and its profits paid for their flying experiments. The big problem: how do you control a machine in the air?

caption.id: Wilbur mengamati burung dan mendapat gagasan memuntir ujung sayap untuk menjaga keseimbangan. Sejak 1900 mereka menguji pesawat layang di Kitty Hawk, Carolina Utara.
caption.en: Wilbur watched birds and got the idea of twisting the wingtips to keep balance. From 1900 they tested gliders at Kitty Hawk, North Carolina.

caption.id: Pesawat layang 1901 tidak terangkat sesuai perhitungan, jadi mereka membuat terowongan angin dan menguji sekitar 200 bentuk sayap. Pada 1902 mereka melakukan ratusan luncuran.
caption.en: Their 1901 glider did not lift as the figures predicted, so they built a wind tunnel and tested about 200 wing shapes. In 1902 they made hundreds of glides.

caption.id: Pada 17 Desember 1903, Orville menerbangkan pesawat bermesin mereka selama 12 detik sejauh sekitar 37 meter. Pada penerbangan keempat hari itu, Wilbur terbang 59 detik sejauh sekitar 260 meter.
caption.en: On 17 December 1903 Orville flew their powered aircraft for 12 seconds, about 37 metres (120 feet). On the fourth flight that day Wilbur flew for 59 seconds, about 260 metres (852 feet).

caption.id: Penerbangan singkat itu membuka zaman pesawat terbang. Kisah mereka mengajak kita belajar dari kegagalan dan menguji lagi dengan data sendiri.
caption.en: That short flight opened the age of the aeroplane. Their story asks us to learn from failure and test again with our own data.

ST-A-HABIBIE.source: Kompas.id (2019): Mr Crack and his message for the nation; detikInet: Julukan Mr Crack BJ Habibie; Wikipedia: B. J. Habibie; Keppres No. 71 Tahun 1995 tentang Hari Kebangkitan Teknologi Nasional

caption.id: B.J. Habibie lahir di Parepare, Sulawesi Selatan, pada 25 Juni 1936. Ia belajar teknik penerbangan di Aachen, Jerman, dan meraih gelar doktor pada 1965.
caption.en: B.J. Habibie was born in Parepare, South Sulawesi, on 25 June 1936. He studied aeronautical engineering in Aachen, Germany, and earned his doctorate in 1965.

caption.id: Badan pesawat bisa retak sedikit demi sedikit karena terus dipakai. Saat itu, insinyur sulit menghitung bagaimana retakan kecil merambat.
caption.en: An aircraft's body can crack little by little through constant use. At the time engineers found it hard to calculate how small cracks spread.

caption.id: Saat bekerja di industri pesawat di Jerman, Habibie ikut mengembangkan perhitungan rambatan retak. Karena itu ia dijuluki «Mr. Crack».
caption.en: While working in Germany's aircraft industry, Habibie helped develop ways to calculate how cracks spread. That earned him the nickname "Mr Crack".

caption.id: Dengan retakan yang bisa dihitung, pesawat dapat dirancang lebih ringan namun tetap aman.
caption.en: Once cracks could be calculated, aircraft could be designed lighter while staying safe.

caption.id: Pada 1974 ia pulang ke Indonesia untuk membangun industri pesawat, yang kini bernama PT Dirgantara Indonesia. Pada 10 Agustus 1995, pesawat N-250 Gatotkaca buatan IPTN terbang perdana di Bandung.
caption.en: In 1974 he returned to Indonesia to build an aircraft industry, now PT Dirgantara Indonesia. On 10 August 1995 the N-250 Gatotkaca, built by IPTN, made its first flight in Bandung.

caption.id: Tanggal itu kini diperingati sebagai Hari Kebangkitan Teknologi Nasional. Habibie wafat pada 11 September 2019; kisahnya mengajak kita menguasai ilmu dan memakainya untuk negeri.
caption.en: That date is now marked as National Technology Awakening Day. Habibie died on 11 September 2019; his story asks us to master knowledge and use it for our country.
